description:
Research Note No.40. Unrefereed, AI-assisted public preprint v1.0,
26 October 2026. Ryutaro Yonezu, Yonezu Research Lab.

For full rectangular unit D4 grids, an interior source, exactly two strict
boundary sinks fixed over an entire shared two-axis tilt box, and deterministic
lowest-strictly-lower-neighbor routing, this note proves that 12 cells is the
exact minimum for failure of corner testing on a nondegenerate closed
axis-aligned parameter rectangle. An integer 4-by-3 terrain has source outlet
A at all four parameter-box corners and B at the center, with the exact rule
A iff |a|+b >= 1 and no interior sink. A complete analytical 3-by-3 obstruction
proves minimality within this specified class.

The deterministic forest is also encoded, including fixed ties, as a unique
rooted minimum spanning forest. This applies established watershed/MSF theory;
the general mechanism is not proposed as new. Historical novelty of the
constrained minimum remains INCONCLUSIVE, and no priority claim is made.

Received external AI reports give mathematical and differential-audit PASS,
including the MSF proof. They did not independently check the cited source
passages or search novelty. Author-side primary-source comparisons and access
limits are included. Human peer review and formal proof-assistant certification
are not claimed. Author verification used Linux/Python 3.12.14; the latest
received review reports Linux/Python 3.13. Windows execution is unconfirmed.
Additional reviewer search code/raw logs were not supplied, and separately
reported search counts are not pooled or presented as author reproductions.

Files: nine-page English PDF and companion ZIP containing the exact audited
v0.5 archive and extracted files, unchanged proof bodies and standard-library
Python verifiers, exact evidence, audit history, editable Markdown and PDF
renderer, the illustrative figure, provenance receipts and SHA256 manifests.
Historical HOLD notes in the frozen originals refer to preparation-stage
review; the author subsequently instructed this qualified public upload.
This does not upgrade novelty, references, Windows or human-review status.

This is a mathematical routing model, not empirical runoff validation.
